desc: Preprocess points — compute perimeter coordinate s, sort by s, keep coordinates.
Fix `can_form(D)` to implement backtracking with chosen list and candidate list.
In backtracking, at each level pick a candidate (ordered by perimeter conflict count), filter remaining candidates to those with Manhattan distance ≥ D, recurse.
Add pruning: if len(remaining_candidates) < k - len(chosen) → return False.
Compute conflict counts via perimeter distance (binary search) to order initial candidates.
Ensure binary search bounds and return correct maximum D.
Test with the three provided examples to verify correctness and fix any issues (e.g., off-by-one errors, incorrect perimeter coordinate calculation, or backtracking bugs).
